system.description: Non-Infernal version of Soul-Twisting Defilement Radiance. Cast from dusk until dawn with paeans to the Unconquered Sun. Tongues of golden flames and lightning play about all those affected as a Holy effect. Natural creatures of darkness such as demons and ghosts within the radius suffer three levels of unsoakable aggravated damage. Beings who are not creatures of darkness regain all Willpower from sacred affirmation. Creatures of darkness within the radius who are not naturally so — such as those bearing the appropriate mutation — lose that status. Non-akuma Solars may explicitly cast this spell even if they have been marked as creatures of darkness.
